notes: Reads files your IT team exports; it does not log in to firewalls, controllers, identity providers, device management or cloud consoles.
Export layouts were written from knowledge of common exports and are confirmed on your own files during setup.
Thresholds such as days to patch, retention days or the number of top admins are working defaults you set; they are not a vendor rule, a standard or a security guarantee.
A finding is a lead for a person to confirm, not proof of an attack, a breach or a saving.
Not legal, compliance or security-certification advice.
Report pages in eight more languages were translated by Claude and are not yet reviewed by native speakers.
warn: Your exports stay on your machine, and names, sign-in names, e-mail addresses, phone numbers and client addresses are masked before anything reaches the AI model. The agents never change a firewall, switch, controller, DNS zone, directory, device or cloud account, and never send, cancel or pay anything: each change is a draft that one named person approves and then makes.
